request: Show days, hours, minutes and seconds, including lower zero units
Remove title and description backgrounds; add glyph shadows

fixes: Countdown uses ceiling whole seconds, exact deadline and full lower-unit chain; timer updates only the visible selected active banner while app is active. No network or database requests per tick.
Title and subtitle scrim and global artwork tint removed; independent glyph shadows use a dark shadow for light text and a light halo for dark custom text.
Native opaque color picker, five accessible presets, independent field resets and reset-all. Preview, draft signature, save, reopen, duplicate and active-toggle preserve styles.
Normal-size editor preview uses full card width so section padding does not incorrectly select the narrow stacked layout. Large text and genuine narrow layouts retain collision-safe separate text.

Presentation version2 stores colors in private presentation documents. Public Firestore banner schema unchanged. Older version1 and legacy saves preserve existing new color settings; version2 empty object explicitly resets them.

Public presentation lookup sanitizes colors. Invalid stored colors fall back without suppressing the catalog; invalid new input is rejected. Owner checks, legal/MFA gates, CAS and idempotency remain enforced.
